fields.FIR_Description: During the morning of 2025-03-11, around 07:35, a wallet containing about Rs. 2,200 and identity cards was picked from the complainant near Mullai Colony Shopping Complex in Coimbatore, according to the complaint recorded on 2025-03-11. Logesh Karuppasamy (9000000198), described as a business acquaintance, was also mentioned in the complaint. No identifying details of the suspected person were available at the time of registration. The complainant mentioned CCTV footage.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Reported theft occurred while the victim was boarding a bus.
fields.Keywords: pickpocketing, wallet, shopping complex, associate, CCTV, morning
